Status.HealthHint: Sum of remaining HP of all body zones

Sheet.Name: Name

Style.MultiAllowed: Allowed by style skills up to
Style.MultiExceeded: More attacks than the style skills allow (max. {n}) – only by agreement with the GM

Skill.anonymous: Anonymous: computer actions cannot be traced; side effects are avoided without a check (security barriers still require checks).
Skill.neo: Neo: the GM reveals the risks and the target number before the check; you may still change your mind.
Skill.crashOverride: Crash-Override: hacking/programming counts as crafting; duration is reduced by 50%.
Skill.beastmaster: Beastmaster: creatures regard you as a friend and attack you last; two fewer Training checks are needed; uncontrolled creatures react positively.
Skill.petPal: Pet Pal: you understand animal speech within limits (agree with the GM).

Skill.goldeneZunge: Golden Tongue: social checks are possible even in unsuitable situations; the addressed target must allow the interaction.
Skill.trickster: Trickster: sleight-of-hand tricks (target number 15); escaping, hiding or pickpocketing once per combat round without an action.
Skill.parkour: Parkour: Climbing and Jumping checks with a target number below 30 succeed automatically.
Skill.rageApplied: Rage of Gods: adrenaline on Strength grants an additional +3D

Style.VariantHint: Chosen PSI power, element or weapon type (e.g. Telekinesis, heat, pistol).
Style.ExtraTargetsHint: Each additional target lowers the effective power level (KS) by 1.
Style.MetamorphoseKs: Metamorphosis: +1 KS for apps of this power
Style.SollbruchHint: No vital spot; damage to the vehicle lowers its maneuver value by 1.
Style.SollbruchNote: Breaking point: attack on the maneuver – on damage maneuver −1, no vital spot

Buff.Unavailable: {source}: target unavailable or no GM active.

Style.HoverDuration: Hovering: stay aloft for {n} combat rounds
Style.PowerNapConfirm: A half-hour nap fully restores (for at most 4 days in a row) and – with food – refills the regeneration pool. Apply now?
Style.PowerNapDone: {name}: Power Nap – adrenaline, meditation and regeneration pool are refilled.
Style.BaKaiDoBite: Ba-Kai-Do 1: biting in melee carries no combat disadvantage.
Style.KenjutsuDraw: Kenjutsu 1: the sword may be drawn and used to attack in the same action.
Style.TwoHits: A hit counts as two hits on two zones (two damage rolls)
Style.EscrimaSwap: Escrima: {skill} instead of the chosen skill (interchangeable)
Style.LegResist: Kick-Boxing: hits to the legs +{n}D on damage resistance
Style.SplitHint: Body, attributes, inventory, wounds and adrenaline stay the same. Skills, PSI powers/apps, character traits and special skills (without languages) belong to the personality's profile and are swapped on switching. Each Split style skill unlocks one more personality.

Style.ClinchBusy: One of the fighters is already in a clinch (one clinch per wrestler).

Style.ClinchEnded: The clinch between {a} and {b} is released.

Sync.Title: Update from compendium
Sync.MenuHint: Compares the items of all characters (texts, values, modifiers, effects) with the system compendium. Back up the world first.
Sync.BackupHint: Back up the world first (Foundry backup or export). Notes, levels, quantities, equipment and ammo states are kept; texts, values, modifiers and effects are taken from the compendium.
Sync.Summary: {n} items with changes. Unchecked items stay unchanged.
Sync.FuzzyHint: Matched only by the name without the bracketed suffix, so unchecked by default. Please review.
Sync.ByNameHint: The item has no compendium source and was matched by name. The source is added when applying.
Sync.OrphanHint: Comes from the compendium but no longer exists there. It is kept; check the box to remove it.
Sync.ConfirmDelete: {n} orphaned items will be removed from the characters. Continue?
Sync.GmOnly: The world-wide comparison is reserved for the GM.
Sync.UpdatePrompt: The system is now version {version}. The compendium has changes for {items} entries on {actors} characters and world documents. Open the preview and choose what to apply?
Sync.NoSyncHint: Excludes this item from the comparison (e.g. for house rules).

Gen.EditNote: Rebuild mode: the generator is pre-filled with this character's values. On apply, only attributes, skills, languages and the catalog items managed by the generator (abnormalities, traits, style skills, advantages, character traits, PSI) are adjusted. Gear, custom items, damage and progress (XP/JP/CP) stay untouched; cart purchases are added and deducted from the existing money. The GP balance reflects the character as it is – overruns are normal for advanced characters.
Gen.ApplyAnyway: There are open issues. Apply anyway?
Gen.NoEditPermission: You may not edit this character.
Gen.Title: Character Generator

Hint.concept: Choose a power level – it sets the GP and the GP to New Dollar rate.
Hint.species: The species costs GP and sets HP, infection resistance, adrenaline, psyche and organism.
Hint.bioMutant: Mutants may invest up to 120 GP in biological traits; hidden traits need conspicuities.
Hint.bioMutation: Each animal mutation grants 5 GP worth of biological traits.
Hint.noBio: Biological traits are only available to mutants or via animal mutation.
Hint.attributes: Attributes start at 1; species bonuses are added afterwards.
Hint.attrCost: Levels 2–3 cost 10 GP each, every further level 20 GP.
Hint.skills: Skills cost 2 GP per level (max 4). The native language at level 5 is free, further languages cost 2 GP per level.
Hint.psi: PSI powers cost 5 GP per level (max 6); one app per level.
Hint.style: Style skills have individual costs and prerequisites. Martial arts cost 5 GP per level.
Hint.advantages: Disadvantages grant markers, advantages spend them (max four disadvantages).
Hint.gear: Convert GP into resources and buy starting equipment.
Hint.butterfly: Roll a red and a white d6 and pick one talent.
Hint.awakened: Awakened may buy design options with GP. Body attributes rise only via full-body packs.
Hint.awakenedAbnormal: Awakened may not choose abnormalities except “Mysterious Implant”.
Hint.adaption: Design option “Robotic adaption” (p. 147): robotic versions of biological traits for up to 80 GP, no conspicuities. Excluded: thick skin/fur, armor plates, adrenaline chambers, enhanced skill, poison resistance, regeneration, pain resistance, sixth sense, improved perception, dense musculature. “Retractable” (+5 GP) is an option on claws, spikes etc.
Hint.awakenedAttributes: Awakened: DEX/STR/CON/AGI start at 2, PER at 3 and rise only via upgrades.
Hint.awakenedGear: Full-body packs under augmentation; maxima DEX 8, STR 20, CON 20, AGI 10.
Hint.n2: Raise two skills up to 6; they gain +1 once.
Hint.mastery: +1 per skill (above maximum), one marker per skill.
Hint.hmo: iHMO get “Unstoppable Shadow”, gHMO choose one power for free. Each further power costs 7 GP.
Hint.meditation: Level 1 is included, each further level costs 5 GP (max. 5).
Hint.adaptionMoved: Awakened get no biological traits – choose Robotic adaption (p. 147) in the species step under design options.

Gen.StartGear: Every character also starts with a SmartCom and shabby clothes.
Gen.AllGood: Everything is valid – ready to create!
Gen.CreateAnyway: There are open issues. Create anyway?

temperature.name: Extreme temperature
temperature.hint: Applies −1D to −3D to all values per temperature band (cat. 1–3). Check every 10 minutes; adjust the status manually afterwards.

acidRain.hint: −1 organism and 1 damage per hour of exposure; material −1 stability per zonat.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.hint: 10 damage per category every 15 minutes, duration category × D6 hours.

toxicWater.name: Toxic water
toxicWater.hint: 60 continuous damage (+10 per combat round in the water).

radiation.hint: Organism loss per zonat/day by category (enter manually); from cat. 7 70–90 continuous damage. Anti-radiation drugs halve it.

radiationLeave.hint: Ends ongoing exposure; the aftereffect (−1 organism per zonat) remains.

Elapsed.Hint: Advances diseases and applies radiation loss (1 zonat = 20 days). Happens automatically with the GM time control.
